title: Kyndryl | 2026 State of Modernization Report
summary: Explore Kyndryl’s State of Modernization Report to learn how AI, continuous modernization and IT complexity are reshaping enterprise technology strategy.
body_markdown:
#### 1.


Modernization is becoming a business capability


When it comes to modernizing, business leaders are placing emphasis on agility, innovation, scalability and control — but the real challenge is turning modernization investments into measurable business outcomes.


Only about half of organizations undergoing modernization report improved IT operations and nearly one in five (18%) say their modernization efforts have delivered limited or unclear value.


Realizing greater value requires a modernization strategy that extends beyond individual technologies and connects technology decisions across architecture, operations, finance, security and the workforce.


#### 2.


AI is reshaping IT modernization


AI is changing what organizations need from their infrastructure — and where modernization needs to happen.


AI ambitions are putting enterprise infrastructure to the test. With 82% of leaders reporting that AI is increasing demands on their network architecture, modernization is becoming critical to supporting what comes next.


As organizations scale AI, modernization strategies must account for the increasing demands on the systems that power the business.


#### 3.


Continuous modernization is gaining ground


Modernization has become an ongoing business priority, not a one-time technology project.


Today, 44% of organizations are making continuous modernization part of their operating model, compared with just 16% taking a “big-bang” approach.


Enterprises that have embraced a continuous modernization approach are gaining greater visibility across their IT estate and more confidence in their understanding of application dependencies.


#### 4.


Delaying modernization has measurable consequences


Postponing efforts to modernize your business's technology estate can create challenges that extend well beyond IT.


Nearly every organization surveyed has postponed a modernization project, with 44% reporting an inability to adopt new capabilities quickly, 43% citing higher long-term costs and 40% experiencing new security or compliance vulnerabilities.


Falling behind on technology can quickly result in falling behind on business priorities — and the longer business leaders wait to modernize, the harder it becomes to keep pace with change.


#### 5.


Agentic AI is emerging as a modernization tool


Agentic AI is starting to change how modernization gets done.


Organizations are beginning to use agentic AI to tackle time-consuming work that can slow modernization, including legacy estate discovery, documentation and code refactoring. Automated testing is emerging as a leading use case, with 43% turning to agentic AI to streamline testing.


Adoption remains early, but organizations leveraging agentic AI in modernization are one-third less likely to report being behind on their modernization goals than non-users.
